value.a: THE FIRST WALK RANKED BY MEANING, MEASURED: the live fire deposited the librarian's first real nodes — Akien's own verbatim design lines, each carrying provenance into the record it came from — and a query sharing almost no words with any of them ('what should the chat interface do...') ranked the chatbot-goal sentence nearest at 0.7473, the payback-meter line last at 0.3721. The embedding IS the path, on real vectors (nomic-embed-text, 768-dim), not fixtures.

DOUBLE PARSIMONY ON THE RE-FIRE: the second run was all DUPLICATEs (the deposit door wrote nothing — Law 1 at the table) AND all cache HITs (the embed seam never touched the host — Law 1 at the meter): misses frozen at 8, avoided-tokens 955 -> 1165. The same interplay the extractor measured, one layer down.

THE SEAL AND THE SOCKET, EXERCISED TOGETHER: this is the first proof that needs the DATABASE run under the netns seal — 1.1.1.1 unreachable inside, postgres still reachable through the Unix socket. db_domain's documented asymmetry stopped being prose and became a measurement.

THE UNTRACEABLE NEVER LANDS: the deposit door requires provenance naming a source — the extractor's fabricated-attribution discipline carried one layer down, where a fake would be a permanent resident, not a refused draft.
